senses.d: Of, pertaining to, characteristic of, or happening or located in, a city or town; of, pertaining to, or characteristic of life in such a place, especially when contrasted with the countryside.
Living in a city or town.
ex: The Epithets of myce are thes; ſhort, ſmall, fearful, peaceable, ridiculous, ruſtik, or country mouſe, vrbane, or citty mouſe, […]

senses.d: Having authority or jurisdiction over a city or town.
Relating to contemporary African American culture, especially in music.
Of an inhabitant or resident: black; African-American.
